content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-97 (bundled/not separately payable). A medical-necessity appeal was already filed but that does not address a bundling denial; the proper remedy is to append the appropriate distinct-service modifier (e.g., 59) and resubmit corrected data. This claim was denied, not paid, so resubmission is not a prohibited duplicate of an adjudicated/paid claim.","action":"correct_and_resubmit"}
